tasks.task: Browse the ESPN+ page from ESPN for a brief summary of what ESPN+ Tools is used for.
tasks.answer: ESPN+ Tools (ESPN+ Fantasy Tools) is a set of subscriber-only fantasy and tournament analysis tools designed to give fans an edge in Fantasy games and Tournament Challenge pools. It includes Bracket Predictor (analyze each matchup and get recommended picks one game at a time), Bracket Analyzer (compare multiple brackets and get recommendations on which to play), PickCenter (expert picks and insights for matchups), and the Custom Dollar Value Generator (create custom player dollar values for fantasy drafts/auctions).
